verdict.rationale: Buzz is fully self-hostable (single-node/VPS compose bundle, Helm chart with external Postgres/Redis/S3) and lets an operator 'run your own relay' anywhere, which indirectly gives control over where data physically resides. However, there is no explicit region/residency feature, multi-region hosting option, or compliance documentation for the hosted/managed offering — residency is only achievable by self-hosting infrastructure yourself. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency controls, documented region selection for any hosted/managed deployment, and compliance (GDPR/SOC2 residency) statements.
